facts.name: Sarah A. Bell
facts.assignment: Nassau County Court Division G; published guide addresses county civil/small claims and separate domestic-violence remote route.

contact.contact_note: Guide labels this address both physical and mailing. Office/assistant number shared; ADA fax is not a chambers fax.

chambers_communications.summary: Email assistant with case number, name and relevant matter; copy all parties unless legally authorized ex parte.

hearing_scheduling.summary: For 15-minute county-civil/small-claims hearings, contact clerk904-548-4600, coordinate parties, then file/serve notice to secure time. For longer hearings, email assistant for availability, coordinate without assistant on the negotiation chain, and obtain confirmation. Motions must already be filed.

conferral.summary: Coordinate hearing availability with the other side before securing the hearing. The guide does not separately establish a universal merits-conferral rule.

proposed_orders.summary: Use linked Fourth Circuit proposed-order e-filing instructions; ordinarily submit within ten days after hearing unless court orders otherwise. Remote-appearance motions instead require filing and assistant notification without a proposed portal order.

courtesy_copies.summary: Submit required case-law copies electronically, with voluminous copies by flash drive. Hearing-material paragraph says three business days; courtesy/exhibit paragraphs say three days. Bring required paper exhibit copies; see source for delivery details.

remote_appearances.summary: File motion and email assistant; request at least five days beforehand. Small-claims pretrials and trials for parties/counsel are in person; witness remote requests require motion. Authorized Zoom appearances require legal name and video; county-civil and domestic-violence meeting routes differ.

conflicts: General hearing-material paragraph says three business days; courtesy-copy/exhibit provisions say three days. Distinct wording retained without resolving timing.
gaps: No separately published personal judge email or chambers fax established; office uses assistant contact.

review_scope.collected: Seven-page original/text; SHA256 matches prior published finding4271. Prior published facts preserved.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts and practical civil communications/scheduling/appearance/submission passages, pages1–5.
review_scope.not_reviewed: No domestic-violence merits, settlement litigation recipes, trial preparation or linked forms. Shared rules remain county-stage review.
